en: Ah, you must be {player}. I've heard about what you've done.
My name is Wallace. I was Sootopolis's Gym Leader once, but other matters called me away, and I left the Gym in my mentor Juan's hands.
Groudon and Kyogre, the two raging out there, are ancient Pokémon from long before people.
But they're not the only ones. There is a third, somewhere: an ancient Pokémon named Rayquaza.
It's said that long ago it was Rayquaza that calmed the other two's fighting. But even I have no idea where it is now...
{player}, do you know where Rayquaza might be? If you do, please tell me.
Sky Pillar? Of course... It must be Sky Pillar!
{player}, there isn't a moment to lose! We're going to Sky Pillar right away!
Mt. Pyre? But when I saw the old woman there, she said nothing of it.
I can't believe she would hide something from me... Could you think about it a little harder?
The Cave of Origin? But that's right here! I need you to do better than that.
Please, think hard about where Rayquaza might be right now.
You don't remember? Hmm... That's a problem. Can't you remember somehow?
